ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import (\\n    register_hook, get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n)\\n\\nUNIVERSE = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\n# Screener ensemble: CLV, peer lead-lag, reversal, risk-adjusted momentum.\\nFACTOR_WEIGHTS = {\\"clv\\": 0.3396, \\"peer\\": 0.2612, \\"reversal\\": 0.2012, \\"momentum\\": 0.1980}\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = 0.015, 0.16\\nbar_count = 0\\n\\n\\ndef cs_rank(values):\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    valid = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    if len(valid) < 2:\\n        return out\\n    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / len(valid)\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef box_simplex(raw):\\n    # Iterative projection to non-negative, full-investment weights with sensible\\n    # 15-asset concentration limits.\\n    w = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, 0.0)), 1e-12) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n    w = {s: x / sum(w.values()) for s, x in w.items()}\\n    fixed = {}\\n    for _ in range(40):\\n        changed = False\\n        for s in UNIVERSE:\\n            if s in fixed:\\n                continue\\n            if w[s] < MIN_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MIN_W; w[s] = MIN_W; changed = True\\n            elif w[s] > MAX_W:\\n                fixed[s] = MAX_W; w[s] = MAX_W; changed = True\\n        free = [s for s in UNIVERSE if s not in fixed]\\n        if not changed:\\n            break\\n        remaining = 1.0 - sum(fixed.values())\\n        base = sum(w[s] for s in free)\\n        if free and base > 0:\\n            for s in free:\\n                w[s] = remaining * w[s] / base\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: float(w[s] / total) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global bar_count\\n    bar_count += 1\\n    account = get_account_dict()\\n    positions = {p.get(\\"symbol\\"): p for p in account.get(\\"positions\\", [])}\\n    # The first allocation is mandatory; thereafter decisions are one per\\n    # ten simulator trading days.  A complete target is always submitted.\\n    invested = any(float(p.get(\\"quantity\\", 0)) > 0 for p in positions.values())\\n    if invested and (bar_count - 1) % 10 != 0:\\n        return\\n\\n    market = {}\\n    for s in UNIVERSE:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=90)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 25:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        l = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        r = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.0\\n        if len(c) >= 22:\\n            market[s] = (c, h, l, r)\\n    if len(market) < 12:\\n        return\\n\\n    clv, peer_base, reversal, momentum, invvol = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}\\n    for s, (c, h, l, r) in market.items():\\n        # One-day close-location value, with rank normalization providing\\n        # cross-sectional winsorization.\\n        clv[s] = float((2.0 * c[-1] - h[-1] - l[-1]) / max(h[-1] - l[-1], 1e-12))\\n        reversal[s] = float(-np.mean(r[-5:]))\\n        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.008)\\n        invvol[s] = 1.0 / vol\\n        momentum[s] = float((c[-1] / max(c[-21], 1e-12) - 1.0) / (vol + 0.01))\\n        peer_base[s] = float(c[-1] / max(c[-6], 1e-12) - 1.0)\\n    median_peer = float(np.median(list(peer_base.values())))\\n    peer = {s: v - median_peer for s, v in peer_base.items()}\\n    ranked = {k: cs_rank(v) for k, v in {\\n        \\"clv\\": clv, \\"peer\\": peer, \\"reversal\\": reversal, \\"momentum\\": momentum\\n    }.items()}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTOR_WEIGHTS[k] * ranked[k][s] for k in ranked) for s in UNIVERSE}\\n\\n    # Medium-high bearish/sideways regime: remain fully invested but shift\\n    # score toward tradable defensive benchmarks rather than cash.\\n    spx = market.get(\\"SPX\\")\\n    if spx is not None:\\n        c = spx[0]\\n        if c[-1] < c[-21] and c[-1] < c[-6]:\\n            for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n                score[s] += 0.18\\n            for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n                score[s] = max(0.05, score[s] - ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nASSETS = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\n# Screener ensemble, capped at six active factors.\\nFACTORS = {\\"clv\\": .270, \\"leadlag\\": .220, \\"rev5\\": .170, \\"mom20\\": .170, \\"rev3\\": .090, \\"down20\\": .080}\\nMIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT = .020, .150\\n_day = 0\\n\\n\\ndef cs_rank(vals):\\n    result = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}\\n    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    if len(good) > 1:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):\\n            result[s] = (i + 1.) / len(good)\\n    return result\\n\\n\\ndef bounded_weights(scores):\\n    w = {s: MIN_WEIGHT for s in ASSETS}\\n    active = set(ASSETS)\\n    left = 1. - MIN_WEIGHT * len(ASSETS)\\n    while active and left > 1e-12:\\n        denom = sum(max(scores[s], .01) for s in active)\\n        capped = [s for s in active if left * max(scores[s], .01) / denom > MAX_WEIGHT - MIN_WEIGHT]\\n        if not capped:\\n            for s in active:\\n                w[s] += left * max(scores[s], .01) / denom\\n            break\\n        for s in capped:\\n            w[s] = MAX_WEIGHT\\n            left -= MAX_WEIGHT - MIN_WEIGHT\\n            active.remove(s)\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / total for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    # One proposal per ten-trading-day block; the helper handles no-trade gates.\\n    if (_day - 1) % 10:\\n        return\\n    data = {}\\n    for s in ASSETS:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=95)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 35:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").reset_index(drop=True)\\n        c = df[\\"close\\"].to_numpy(float)\\n        h = df[\\"high\\"].to_numpy(float)\\n        l = df[\\"low\\"].to_numpy(float)\\n        if len(c) < 32 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-32:])) or c[-1] <= 0:\\n            continue\\n        r = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.\\n        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .008)\\n        dvol = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.))), .004)\\n        data[s] = {\\n            \\"clv\\": (2*c[-1]-h[-1]-l[-1]) / max(h[-1]-l[-1], 1e-12),\\n            \\"r5\\": c[-1] / max(c[-6], 1e-12)-1.,\\n            \\"rev5\\": -float(np.mean(r[-5:])),\\n            \\"rev3\\": -float(np.mean(r[-3:])),\\n            \\"mom20\\": (c[-1]/max(c[-21],1e-12)-1.)/(vol+.01),\\n            \\"down20\\": (c[-1]/max(c[-21],1e-12)-1.)/(dvol+.01),\\n            \\"invvol\\": 1./vol,\\n            \\"trend\\": c[-1]/max(c[-31],1e-12)-1.\\n        }\\n    # Small missing-data gaps receive neutral ranks; still submit all 15 assets.\\n    if len(data) < 10:\\n        return\\n    median5 = float(np.median([x[\\"r5\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    raw = {\\n        \\"clv\\": {s:x[\\"clv\\"] for s,x in data.items()},\\n        \\"leadlag\\": {s:x[\\"r5\\"]-median5 for s,x in data.items()},\\n        \\"rev5\\": {s:x[\\"rev5\\"] for s,x in data.items()},\\n        \\"mom20\\": {s:x[\\"mom20\\"] for s,x in data.items()},\\n        \\"rev3\\": {s:x[\\"rev3\\"] for s,x in data.items()},\\n        \\"down20\\": {s:x[\\"down20\\"] for s,x in data.items()}\\n    }\\n    ranks = {f:cs_rank(v) for f,v in raw.items()}\\n    score = {s:sum(FACTORS[f]*ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n    eq = [data[s] for s in (\\"000300.SH\\",\\"SPX\\",\\"HSI\\",\\"N225\\",\\"SX5E\\",\\"NDX\\") if s in data]\\n    breadth = sum(x[\\"trend\\"] < 0 for x in eq) / max(1, len(eq))\\n    if breadth >= .5 or (data.get(\\"SPX\\",{}).get(\\"trend\\",0) < 0 and data.get(\\"SPX\\",{}).get(\\"r5\\",0) < 0):\\n        # Defensive tradable assets substitute for cash in the bearish regime.\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            score[s] += .10\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n            score[s] = max(.02, score[s]-.05)\\n\\n    med_iv = float(np.median([x[\\"invvol\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    for s in ASSETS:\\n        iv = data.get(s, {}).get(\\"invvol\\", med_iv)\\n        score[s] = max(.02, score[s]) * (.92 + .08*iv/max(med_iv,1e-12))\\n    target = bounded_weights(score)\\n    if all(np.isfinite(target[s]) and target[s] >= 0 for s in ASSETS) and abs(sum(target.values())-1.) < 1e-8:\\n        rebalance_to_weights(target)\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_lJXAhBNBbqvbouZwidmHR6P6', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_080c1eacff2bd9eb016a7aab68940c81a298b7b13c2d05eebf', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

_day = 0


def cs_rank(vals):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}

    n = len(good)
    if n > 1:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out


def bounded_weights(scores):
    # Full investment with sensible diversification for a 15-name universe.
    w = {s: MIN_WEIGHT for s in ASSETS}
    active = set(ASSETS)
    left = 1.0 - MIN_WEIGHT * len(ASSETS)
    while active and left > 1e-12:

        capped = [s for s in active if left * max(float(scores[s]), .01) / denom > MAX_WEIGHT - MIN_WEIGHT]

active = set(ASSETS)\\n    residual = 1. - MIN_W * len(ASSETS)\\n    while active and residual > 1e-12:\\n        q = {s: max(float(score[s]), .01) for s in active}\\n        z = sum(q.values())\\n        capped = [s for s in active if residual * q[s] / z > MAX_W - MIN_W]\\n        if not capped:\\n            for s in active: w[s] += residual * q[s] / z\\n            break\\n        for s in capped:\\n            w[s] = MAX_W; residual -= MAX_W - MIN_W; active.remove(s)\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % 10: return\\n    d = {}\\n    for s in ASSETS:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=95)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 35: continue\\n        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\").close, dtype=float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\").high, dtype=float)\\n        l = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\\"date\\").low, dtype=float)\\n        if len(c) < 32 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-32:])) or c[-1] <= 0: continue\\n        rr = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.\\n        vol = max(float(np.std(rr[-20:])), .008)\\n        dvol = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(rr[-20:], 0.))), .004)\\n        d[s] = {\\"clv\\": (2*c[-1]-h[-1]-l[-1]) / max(h[-1]-l[-1], 1e-12),\\n                \\"r5\\": c[-1]/c[-6]-1., \\"rev5\\": -float(np.mean(rr[-5:])),\\n                \\"rev3\\": -float(np.mean(rr[-3:])), \\"mom20\\": (c[-1]/c[-21]-1.)/(vol+.01),\\n                \\"down20\\": (c[-1]/c[-21]-1.)/(dvol+.01), \\"trend\\": c[-1]/c[-31]-1.,\\n                \\"invvol\\": 1./vol}\\n    if len(d) < 10: return\\n    med = float(np.median([x[\\"r5\\"] for x in d.values()]))\\n    raw = {f: {} for f in FACTORS}\\n    for s, x in d.items():\\n        raw[\\"clv\\"][s] = x[\\"clv\\"]; def rank_cs(x):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    if n > 1:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good): out[s] = (i + 1.) / n

def make_weights(score):
    # Floor every tradable asset, then distribute residual subject to a cap.
    w = {s: MIN_W for s in ASSETS}
    active, residual = set(ASSETS), 1. - MIN_W * len(ASSETS)
    while active and residual > 1e-12:
        q = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), .01) for s in active}
        total = sum(q.values())
        capped = [s for s in active if residual * q[s] / total > MAX_W - MIN_W]

            for s in active: w[s] += residual * q[s] / total
            break
        for s in capped:
            w[s] = MAX_W
            residual -= MAX_W - MIN_W
            active.remove(s)

    return {s: w[s] / z for s in ASSETS}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Current screener ensemble; six active factors, total weight 1.
FACTORS = {"clv": .28, "leadlag": .22, "mom20": .17, "rev5": .17, "down20": .08, "rev3": .08}
MIN_W, MAX_W = .02, .15
_day = 0

def rank_cs(x):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    if n > 1:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out

def make_weights(score):
    # Diversified full investment: 2% floor and 15% cap across all 15 assets.
    w = {s: MIN_W for s in ASSETS}
    active, residual = set(ASSETS), 1.0 - MIN_W * len(ASSETS)
    while active and residual > 1e-12:
        q = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), .01) for s in active}
        total = sum(q.values())
        capped = [s for s in active if residual * q[s] / total > MAX_W - MIN_W]
        if not capped:
            for s in active: w[s] += residual * q[s] / total
            break
        for s in capped:
            w[s] = MAX_W
            residual -= MAX_W - MIN_W
            active.remove(s)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in ASSETS}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % 10:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=95)
        if df is None or len(df) < 35:
            continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], dtype=float)
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], dtype=float)
        lo = np.asarray(df["low"], dtype=float)
        if len(c) < 32 or not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-32:])) or c[-1] <= 0:
            continue
        r = c[1:] / np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12) - 1.0
        vol = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .008)
        dvol = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0))), .004)
        data[s] = {"clv": (2*c[-1]-hi[-1]-lo[-1]) / max(hi[-1]-lo[-1], 1e-12),
                   "r5": c[-1]/c[-6]-1.0, "rev5": -float(np.mean(r[-5:])),
                   "rev3": -float(np.mean(r[-3:])),
                   "mom20": (c[-1]/c[-21]-1.0)/(vol+.01),
                   "down20": (c[-1]/c[-21]-1.0)/(dvol+.01),
                   "trend": c[-1]/c[-31]-1.0, "invvol": 1.0/vol}
    if len(data) < 10:
        return
    med5 = float(np.median([v["r5"] for v in data.values()]))
    raw = {f: {} for f in FACTORS}
    for s, v in data.items():
        raw["clv"][s] = v["clv"]
        raw["leadlag"][s] = v["r5"] - med5
        for f in ("mom20", "rev5", "down20", "rev3"):
            raw[f][s] = v[f]
    ranks = {f: rank_cs(x) for f, x in raw.items()}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[f] * ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}

    # Bear regime: remain fully invested but shift toward defensive tradable assets.
    eq = [data[s] for s in ("000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "NDX") if s in data]
    bearish = (len(eq) >= 3 and sum(v["trend"] < 0 for v in eq) / len(eq) >= .5)
    bearish = bearish or (data.get("SPX", {}).get("trend", 0) < 0 and data.get("SPX", {}).get("r5", 0) < 0)
    if bearish:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"):
            score[s] += .10
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"):
            score[s] = max(.02, score[s] - .05)

    med_iv = float(np.median([v["invvol"] for v in data.values()]))
    for s in ASSETS:
        score[s] = max(.02, score[s]) * (.92 + .08 * data.get(s, {}).get("invvol", med_iv) / max(med_iv, 1e-12))
    target = make_weights(score)
    if (set(target) == set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values())
            and abs(sum(target.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-8):
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Screener ensemble, nine active factors (directions are all positive).
FACTORS = {"mom20": .20, "mom30": .16, "clv1": .10, "lead5": .10,
           "resid30": .10, "downmom20": .10, "rev5": .08,
           "persist30": .08, "eff20": .08}
MIN_W, MAX_W = .02, .14
_day = 0

def cross_rank(x):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    a = sorted((s, v) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if len(a) > 1:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(a): out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(a)
    return out

def weights(score):
    raw = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), .05) for s in ASSETS}
    w = {s: MIN_W + (1 - MIN_W*len(ASSETS))*raw[s]/sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    # cap high scores and redistribute, retaining a diversified full-investment book
    for _ in range(8):
        over = sum(max(0., w[s]-MAX_W) for s in ASSETS)
        if over < 1e-10: break
        capped = {s for s in ASSETS if w[s] >= MAX_W-1e-10}
        for s in capped: w[s] = MAX_W
        free = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in capped]
        if not free: break
        z = sum(raw[s] for s in free)
        for s in free: w[s] += over*raw[s]/z
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s]/z for s in ASSETS}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % 10 != 0:
        return
    d = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=170)
        if df is None or len(df) < 50: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        c = np.asarray(df["close"], float)
        hi = np.asarray(df["high"], float); lo = np.asarray(df["low"], float)
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(c[-40:])): continue
        r = c[1:]/np.maximum(c[:-1], 1e-12)-1.
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .008)
        downside = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.))), .004)
        r5 = c[-1]/c[-6]-1.; r20 = c[-1]/c[-21]-1.; r30 = c[-1]/c[-31]-1.
        clv = float(np.nanmean((2*c[-3:] - hi[-3:] - lo[-3:]) / np.maximum(hi[-3:]-lo[-3:], 1e-12)))
        p20 = float(np.mean(r[-20:] > 0)); p30 = float(np.mean(r[-30:] > 0))
        d[s] = {"mom20": r20/(v20+.01)*(.5+p20),
                "mom30": r30/(v20+.01)*(.5+p30), "clv1": clv,
                "lead5": r5, "resid30": r30/(v20+.01),
                "downmom20": r20/(downside+.01), "rev5": -float(np.mean(r[-5:])),
                "persist30": r30/(v20+.01)*p30, "eff20": r20/(downside+.015),
                "trend": r30, "vol": v20}
    if len(d) < 10: return
    # Cross-sectional ranks are robust to scale and missing macro coverage.
    ranks = {f: cross_rank({s: d[s][f] for s in d}) for f in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[f]*ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    eqnames = ("000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "NDX")
    eq = [d[s] for s in eqnames if s in d]
    breadth = sum(x["trend"] > 0 for x in eq)/max(len(eq), 1)
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    high_risk = medvol > .018 or breadth < .67
    bear = len(eq) >= 3 and (breadth <= .50 or (d.get("SPX", {}).get("trend", 0) < 0 and d.get("SPX", {}).get("lead5", 0) < 0))
    if high_risk or bear:
        bump = .12 if bear else .075
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += bump
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"): score[s] = max(.05, score[s] - (.06 if bear else .035))
    # Only a mild inverse-volatility overlay; avoid pro-cyclical concentration.
    invmed = float(np.median([1./x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    for s in ASSETS:
        iv = 1./d[s]["vol"] if s in d else invmed
        score[s] *= .985 + .015*iv/max(invmed, 1e-12)
    target = weights(score)
    if set(target) == set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()) and abs(sum(target.values())-1) < 1e-8:
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nASSETS = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\n# Screener ensemble (8 active factors, all positive direction).\\nFACTORS = {\\"mom20\\": .07, \\"mom30\\": .07, \\"resid30\\": .06, \\"downmom\\": .24,\\n           \\"eff\\": .22, \\"persist\\": .08, \\"lead\\": .17, \\"rev\\": .09}\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = .025, .16\\n_day = 0\\n\\n\\ndef rank_cs(vals):\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}\\n    valid = [(s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v)]\\n    valid.sort(key=lambda z: z[1])\\n    n = len(valid)\\n    if n > 1:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid):\\n            out[s] = (i + 1.) / n\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef bounded_weights(scores):\\n    # Positive score transform keeps all 15 assets invested; caps limit concentration.\\n    raw = {s: max(.05, float(scores.get(s, .5))) for s in ASSETS}\\n    base = 1. - MIN_W * len(ASSETS)\\n    w = {s: MIN_W + base * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}\\n    for _ in range(20):\\n        over = sum(max(0., w[s] - MAX_W) for s in ASSETS)\\n        if over < 1e-10:\\n            break\\n        capped = {s for s in ASSETS if w[s] >= MAX_W - ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nASSETS = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\n# Current screener ensemble (six active factors, all long direction).\\nFACTORS = {\\"cons20\\": 0.30, \\"cons30\\": 0.20, \\"persist30\\": 0.16,\\n           \\"downmom\\": 0.14, \\"eff\\": 0.10, \\"resid\\": 0.10}\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = 0.03, 0.15\\n_day = 0\\n\\n\\ndef rank_cs(values):\\n    out = {s: 0.5 for s in ASSETS}\\n    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    n = len(good)\\n    if n > 1:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):\\n            out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n\\n    elif n == 1:\\n        out[good[0][0]] = 0.5\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef bounded(raw_score):\\n    raw = {s: max(0.05, float(raw_score.get(s, 0.5))) for s in ASSETS}\\n    base = 1.0 - MIN_W * len(ASSETS)\\n    w = {s: MIN_W + base * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}\\n    # Iterative cap redistribution preserves non-negative full investment.\\n    for _ in range(30):\\n        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W + 1e-10]\\n        if not over:\\n            break\\n        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in over)\\n        for s in over:\\n            w[s] = MAX_W\\n        free = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in over]\\n        den = sum(raw[s] for s in free)\\n        if not free or den <= 0:\\n            break\\n        for s in free:\\n            w[s] += excess * raw[s] / den\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: max(0.0, w[s] / z) for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % 10 != 0:\\n        return\\n    data = {}\\n    for s in ASSETS:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=190)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 65:\\n            continue\\n        df = df.sort_values(\\"date\\")\\n        c = np.asarray(df[\\"close\\"], dtype=float)\\n        h = np.asarray(df[\\"high\\"], dtype=float)\\n        l = np.asarray(df[\\"low\\"], dtype=float)\\n        if np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-65:])) or np.any(c[-65:] <= 0):\\n            continue\\n        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0\\n        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), 0.006)\\n        dn20 = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0))), 0.003)\\n        t20, t30 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.0, c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.0\\n        p20, p30 = np.mean(r[-20:] > 0), np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)\\n        # Range-adjusted persistence: return per typical true range, gated by breadth.\\n        rng = np.maximum(h[-30:] - l[-30:], c[-30:] * 0.001)\\n        range_rate = max(float(np.mean(rng / c[-30:])), 0.002)\\n        data[s] = {\\n            \\"cons20\\": t20 / (v20 + 0.01) * (0.5 + p20),\\n            \\"cons30\\": t30 / (v20 + 0.01) * (0.5 + p30),\\n            \\"persist30\\": t30 / (range_rate + 0.01) * (0.5 + p30),\\n            \\"downmom\\": t20 / (dn20 + 0.01),\\n            \\"eff\\": t20 / (dn20 + 0.015),\\n            \\"resid_raw\\": t30, \\"t30\\": t30, \\"vol\\": v20,\\n        }\\n    if len(data) < 10:\\n        return\\n    med_t30 = float(np.median([x[\\"t30\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    for x in data.values():\\n        x[\\"resid\\"] = x[\\"resid_raw\\"] - med_t30\\n    ranks = {f: rank_cs({s: x[f] for s, x in data.items()}) for f in FACTORS}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[f] * ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n    # High-risk sideways/bullish overlay: full investment, defensive tilt only.\\n    eq = [data[s] for s in (\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"NDX\\") if s in data]\\n    breadth = float(np.mean([x[\\"t30\\"] > 0 for x in eq])) if eq else 0.5\\n    medvol = float(np.median([x[\\"vol\\"] for x in data.values()]))\\n    spx = data.get(\\"SPX\\", {})\\n    bear = breadth <= 0.50 or (spx.get(\\"t30\\", 0) < 0 and spx.get(\\"resid\\", 0) < 0)\\n    high_risk = medvol > 0.018 or breadth < 0.67\\n    if bear or high_risk:\\n        boost = 0.12 if bear else 0.07\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            score[s] += boost\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"):\\n            score[s] = max(0.05, score[s] - ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]

FACTORS = {"cg20": .22, "eff20": .18, "cg30": .15, "down20": .14,
           "persist30": .10, "mktres30": .09, "dxyres30": .07, "peer5": .05}
REBALANCE_DAYS = 10
POSITION_SCALING = .28
MIN_W, MAX_W = .04, .14
_day = 0


def cs_rank(vals):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out


def project_weights(score, invvol):
    raw = {s: max(.25, .5 + POSITION_SCALING * (score[s] - .5)) *
           np.clip(invvol.get(s, 1.0), .70, 1.30) for s in ASSETS}
    w = {s: MIN_W + (1 - len(ASSETS)*MIN_W) * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    # Cap concentration while redistributing excess among uncapped assets.
    for _ in range(30):
        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W + 1e-12]
        if not over: break
        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in over)
        for s in over: w[s] = MAX_W
        free = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in over]
        den = sum(raw[s] for s in free)
        if not free or den <= 0: break
        for s in free: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / den
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: max(0.0, w[s] / z) for s in ASSETS}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=115)
        if df is None or len(df) < 75: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The last row may be today's incomplete bar; exclude it.
        c = np.asarray(df.close, dtype=float)[:-1]
        hi = np.asarray(df.high, dtype=float)[:-1]
        lo = np.asarray(df.low, dtype=float)[:-1]
        if len(c) < 65 or np.any(c[-65:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.0
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        dn = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0))), .003)
        t5, t20, t30 = c[-1]/c[-6]-1, c[-1]/c[-21]-1, c[-1]/c[-31]-1
        p20, p30 = np.mean(r[-20:] > 0), np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)
        # Proxies preserve the selected factor directions using price/OHLC only.
        gate20 = .5 + .5 * max(0.0, 2*p20 - 1.0)
        gate30 = .5 + .5 * max(0.0, 2*p30 - 1.0)
        path = np.sum(np.abs(r[-30:])) + 1e-6
        persistence = t30 / path
        data[s] = {"cg20": t20/(v20+.01)*gate20,
                   "eff20": t20/(dn+.015),
                   "cg30": t30/(v20+.01)*gate30,
                   "down20": t20/(dn+.01), "persist30": persistence,
                   "peer5": t5, "mktres30": t30, "dxyres30": t30,
                   "v": v20, "t30": t30}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    med30 = np.median([x["t30"] for x in data.values()])
    med5 = np.median([x["peer5"] for x in data.values()])
    for x in data.values():
        x["mktres30"] = x["t30"] - med30
        # DXY observation data is not required for a stable fallback proxy;
        # residualizing against the cross-section avoids market-beta crowding.
        x["dxyres30"] = x["t30"] - med30
        x["peer5"] -= med5
    ranks = {k: cs_rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k] * ranks[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth = np.mean([x["t30"] > 0 for x in data.values()])
    medvol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    if breadth < .50 or medvol > .018:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .16
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"): score[s] -= .10
    invvol = {s: np.clip(medvol / max(x["v"], .006), .70, 1.30) for s, x in data.items()}
    rebalance_to_weights(project_weights(score, invvol))


def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()

           "persist30": .10, "mktres30": .09, "dxyres30": .07, "peer5": .05}
REBALANCE_DAYS = 10
POSITION_SCALING = .28
MIN_W, MAX_W = .04, .14
_day = 0


def cs_rank(vals):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    good = sorted((s, v) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.0) / n
    return out


def project_weights(score, invvol):
    raw = {s: max(.25, .5 + POSITION_SCALING * (score[s] - .5)) *
           np.clip(invvol.get(s, 1.0), .70, 1.30) for s in ASSETS}
    w = {s: MIN_W + (1 - len(ASSETS)*MIN_W) * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    # Cap concentration while redistributing excess among uncapped assets.
    for _ in range(30):
        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W + 1e-12]
        if not over: break
        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in over)
        for s in over: w[s] = MAX_W
        free = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in over]
        den = sum(raw[s] for s in free)
        if not free or den <= 0: break
        for s in free: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / den
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: max(0.0, w[s] / z) for s in ASSETS}


@register_hook

    _day += 1

        return

        if df is None or len(df) < 75: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")

        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        dn = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r[-20:], 0.0))), .003)
        t5, t20, t30 = c[-1]/c[-6]-1, c[-1]/c[-21]-1, c[-1]/c[-31]-1
        p20, p30 = np.mean(r[-20:] > 0), np.mean(r[-30:] > 0)
        # Proxies preserve the selected factor directions using price/OHLC only.
        gate20 = .5 + .5 * max(0.0, 2*p20 - 1.0)
        gate30 = .5 + .5 * max(0.0, 2*p30 - 1.0)
        path = np.sum(np.abs(r[-30:])) + 1e-6
        persistence = t30 / path
        data[s] = {"cg20": t20/(v20+.01)*gate20,
                   "eff20": t20/(dn+.015),
                   "cg30": t30/(v20+.01)*gate30,
                   "down20": t20/(dn+.01), "persist30": persistence,
                   "peer5": t5, "mktres30": t30, "dxyres30": t30,
                   "v": v20, "t30": t30}
    if len(data) < 10: return
    med30 = np.median([x["t30"] for x in data.values()])
    med5 = np.median([x["peer5"] for x in data.values()])
    for x in data.values():
        x["mktres30"] = x["t30"] - med30

        x["peer5"] -= med5
    ranks = {k: cs_rank({s: x[k] for s, x in data.items()}) for k in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k] * ranks[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth = np.mean([x["t30"] > 0 for x in data.values()])
    medvol = float(np.median([x["v"] for x in data.values()]))
    if breadth < .50 or medvol > .018:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .16
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"): score[s] -= .10
    invvol = {s: np.clip(medvol / max(x["v"], .006), .70, 1.30) for s, x in data.items()}
    rebalance_to_weights(project_weights(score, invvol))


def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Current screener ensemble; all inputs are lagged completed-day observations.
FACTORS = {"shock": .18, "mom30": .16, "clv": .12, "rev5": .12,
           "mom20": .11, "mktres": .10, "dxyres": .08,
           "downmom": .07, "eff": .06}
REBALANCE_DAYS = 10
POSITION_SCALING = .12
MIN_W, MAX_W = .035, .16
_day = 0


def rank(values):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    a = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(a):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(a)
    return out


def weights(score, invvol):
    raw = {s: max(.45, .5 + POSITION_SCALING * (score[s] - .5)) *
           np.clip(invvol.get(s, 1.), .75, 1.25) for s in ASSETS}
    free = 1. - len(ASSETS) * MIN_W
    w = {s: MIN_W + free * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    # Simple capped redistribution, followed by normalization for exact invariant.
    for _ in range(20):
        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not over: break
        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in over)
        for s in over: w[s] = MAX_W
        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in over]
        den = sum(raw[s] for s in rest)
        if not rest or den <= 0: break
        for s in rest: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / den
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: max(0., w[s] / z) for s in ASSETS}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:
        return
    f, rets = {}, {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=130)
        if df is None or len(df) < 75: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is not used: decisions see only the prior completed day.
        d = df.iloc[:-1]
        c = np.asarray(d["close"], float)
        if len(c) < 70 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-70:])) or np.any(c[-70:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.
        r20, r30 = r[-20:], r[-30:]
        vol = max(float(np.std(r20)), .006)
        downside = max(float(np.std(np.minimum(r20, 0.))), .003)
        t20, t30 = c[-1]/c[-21]-1., c[-1]/c[-31]-1.
        # Positive reversal scores favor recent stress selloffs, not persistent winners.
        shock = -float(np.sum(r[-3:])) / (vol + .01)
        rev5 = -float(np.sum(r[-5:])) / (vol + .01)
        p20, p30 = np.mean(r20 > 0), np.mean(r30 > 0)
        f[s] = {"shock": shock, "mom30": t30/(vol+.01) * (.5+.5*max(0,2*p30-1)),
                "mom20": t20/(vol+.01) * (.5+.5*max(0,2*p20-1)),
                "rev5": rev5, "downmom": t20/(downside+.01),
                "eff": t20/(np.sum(np.abs(r20))+.00001), "t30": t30, "vol": vol}
        # CLV is a pressure measure averaged over recent available bars.
        if all(k in d.columns for k in ("high", "low", "close", "open")):
            hi, lo, op = np.asarray(d["high"][-10:],float), np.asarray(d["low"][-10:],float), np.asarray(d["open"][-10:],float)
            cl = np.where(hi > lo, (2*np.asarray(d["close"][-10:],float)-hi-lo)/(hi-lo), 0.)
            f[s]["clv"] = float(np.mean(cl))
        else: f[s]["clv"] = 0.
        rets[s] = r[-30:]
    if len(f) < 10: return
    med_t = float(np.median([x["t30"] for x in f.values()]))
    dxy = get_index_daily_data(symbol="DXY", days=130)
    dx = None
    if dxy is not None and len(dxy) > 35:
        dc = np.asarray(dxy.sort_values("date")["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(dc) >= 31 and np.all(np.isfinite(dc[-31:])) and np.all(dc[-31:] > 0): dx = dc[1:]/dc[:-1]-1.
    for s, x in f.items():
        x["mktres"] = x["t30"] - med_t
        x["dxyres"] = x["t30"]
        if dx is not None and len(dx) >= 30:
            ar, dr = rets[s][-30:], dx[-30:]
            var = float(np.var(dr))
            beta = float(np.cov(ar, dr, ddof=0)[0,1]/var) if var > 1e-10 else 0.
            x["dxyres"] = x["t30"] - beta*float(np.sum(dr))
    ranks = {k: rank({s:x[k] for s,x in f.items()}) for k in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k]*ranks[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth = np.mean([x["t30"] > 0 for x in f.values()])
    medvol = np.median([x["vol"] for x in f.values()])
    # Bear/high-risk: express risk-off view only through tradable defensives.
    if breadth < .50 or medvol > .018:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .24
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"): score[s] -= .18
    invvol = {s: np.clip(medvol/max(x["vol"], .006), .75, 1.25) for s,x in f.items()}
    rebalance_to_weights(weights(score, invvol))


def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()

# Current screener ensemble; all inputs are lagged completed-day observations.
FACTORS = {"shock": .18, "mom30": .16, "clv": .12, "rev5": .12,
           "mom20": .11, "mktres": .10, "dxyres": .08,
           "downmom": .07, "eff": .06}
REBALANCE_DAYS = 10
POSITION_SCALING = .12
MIN_W, MAX_W = .035, .16
_day = 0


def rank(values):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    a = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(a):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / len(a)
    return out


def weights(score, invvol):
    raw = {s: max(.45, .5 + POSITION_SCALING * (score[s] - .5)) *
           np.clip(invvol.get(s, 1.), .75, 1.25) for s in ASSETS}
    free = 1. - len(ASSETS) * MIN_W
    w = {s: MIN_W + free * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    # Simple capped redistribution, followed by normalization for exact invariant.
    for _ in range(20):
        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W]
        if not over: break
        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in over)
        for s in over: w[s] = MAX_W
        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in over]
        den = sum(raw[s] for s in rest)
        if not rest or den <= 0: break
        for s in rest: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / den
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: max(0., w[s] / z) for s in ASSETS}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:
        return
    f, rets = {}, {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=130)
        if df is None or len(df) < 75: continue
        df = df.sort_values("date")
        # The final row is not used: decisions see only the prior completed day.
        d = df.iloc[:-1]
        c = np.asarray(d["close"], float)
        if len(c) < 70 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-70:])) or np.any(c[-70:] <= 0): continue

        # Positive reversal scores favor recent stress selloffs, not persistent winners.
        shock = -float(np.sum(r[-3:])) / (vol + .01)
        rev5 = -float(np.sum(r[-5:])) / (vol + .01)

        f[s] = {"shock": shock, "mom30": t30/(vol+.01) * (.5+.5*max(0,2*p30-1)),
                "mom20": t20/(vol+.01) * (.5+.5*max(0,2*p20-1)),
                "rev5": rev5, "downmom": t20/(downside+.01),
                "eff": t20/(np.sum(np.abs(r20))+.00001), "t30": t30, "vol": vol}
        # CLV is a pressure measure averaged over recent available bars.
        if all(k in d.columns for k in ("high", "low", "close", "open")):
            hi, lo, op = np.asarray(d["high"][-10:],float), np.asarray(d["low"][-10:],float), np.asarray(d["open"][-10:],float)
            cl = np.where(hi > lo, (2*np.asarray(d["close"][-10:],float)-hi-lo)/(hi-lo), 0.)
            f[s]["clv"] = float(np.mean(cl))
        else: f[s]["clv"] = 0.
        rets[s] = r[-30:]
    if len(f) < 10: return
    med_t = float(np.median([x["t30"] for x in f.values()]))
    dxy = get_index_daily_data(symbol="DXY", days=130)
    dx = None
    if dxy is not None and len(dxy) > 35:
        dc = np.asarray(dxy.sort_values("date")["close"], float)[:-1]
        if len(dc) >= 31 and np.all(np.isfinite(dc[-31:])) and np.all(dc[-31:] > 0): dx = dc[1:]/dc[:-1]-1.
    for s, x in f.items():
        x["mktres"] = x["t30"] - med_t
        x["dxyres"] = x["t30"]
        if dx is not None and len(dx) >= 30:
            ar, dr = rets[s][-30:], dx[-30:]
            var = float(np.var(dr))
            beta = float(np.cov(ar, dr, ddof=0)[0,1]/var) if var > 1e-10 else 0.
            x["dxyres"] = x["t30"] - beta*float(np.sum(dr))
    ranks = {k: rank({s:x[k] for s,x in f.items()}) for k in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k]*ranks[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth = np.mean([x["t30"] > 0 for x in f.values()])
    medvol = np.median([x["vol"] for x in f.values()])
    # Bear/high-risk: express risk-off view only through tradable defensives.
    if breadth < .50 or medvol > .018:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .24
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"): score[s] -= .18
    invvol = {s: np.clip(medvol/max(x["vol"], .006), .75, 1.25) for s,x in f.items()}
    rebalance_to_weights(weights(score, invvol))


def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()

.5)) *\\n              np.clip(invvol.get(s, 1.), .72, 1.28) for s in ASSETS}\\n    base = len(ASSETS) * MIN_W\\n    w = {s: MIN_W + (1. - base) * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}\\n    for _ in range(20):\\n        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W]\\n        if not over:\\n            break\\n        excess = sum(w[s] - ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights\\n\\nASSETS = [\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"]\\nFACTORS = {\\"risktrend\\": .28, \\"quiet\\": .22, \\"accel\\": .18, \\"cons30\\": .12, \\"persist30\\": .10, \\"mktres\\": .05, \\"rev5\\": .05}\\nREBALANCE_DAYS = 10\\nMIN_W, MAX_W = .04, .14\\n_day = 0\\n\\ndef cs_rank(values):\\n    valid = sorted((s, v) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}\\n    n = len(valid)\\n    if n:\\n        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(valid): out[s] = (i + 1.) / n\\n    return out\\n\\ndef make_weights(score, invvol):\\n    raw = {s: max(.05, .5 + .045 * (score[s] - .5)) * np.clip(invvol.get(s, 1.), .7, 1.3) for s in ASSETS}\\n    w = {s: MIN_W + (1 - len(ASSETS) * MIN_W) * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}\\n    for _ in range(20):\\n        high = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W + 1e-10]\\n        if not high: break\\n        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in high)\\n        for s in high: w[s] = MAX_W\\n        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in high]\\n        z = sum(raw[s] for s in rest)\\n        for s in rest: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / z\\n    z = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: w[s] / z for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0: return\\n    feat = {}\\n    for s in ASSETS:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=190)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 80: continue\\n        d = df.sort_values(\\"date\\").iloc[:-1]  # completed bars only\\n        c = np.asarray(d.close, float); h = np.asarray(d.high, float); lo = np.asarray(d.low, float)\\n        if len(c) < 65 or np.any(c[-65:] <= 0): continue\\n        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.; r20, r30 = r[-20:], r[-30:]\\n        vol = max(float(np.std(r20)), .006); scale = vol + .01\\n        t20, t30 = c[-1]/c[-21]-1., c[-1]/c[-31]-1.\\n        cons30, cons20 = np.mean(r30 > 0), np.mean(r20 > 0)\\n        rng = np.maximum(h[-20:] - lo[-20:], 1e-12)\\n        quiet = (t30 / scale) * (.5 + .5 * cons30)\\n        accel = ((t20 - t30) / scale) * (.5 + .5 * cons20)\\n        # Range-adjusted persistence: trend relative to realized range.\\n        persist = t30 / max(float(np.mean(rng / c[-20:])), .005) * (.5 + .5*cons30)\\n        feat[s] = {\\"risktrend\\": t20/scale, \\"quiet\\": quiet, \\"accel\\": accel,\\n                   \\"cons30\\": cons30, \\"persist30\\": persist, \\"rev5\\": -np.sum(r[-5:])/scale,\\n                   \\"t30\\": t30, \\"vol\\": vol}\\n    if len(feat) < 10: return\\n    med = np.median([x[\\"t30\\"] for x in feat.values()])\\n    for x in feat.values(): x[\\"mktres\\"] = x[\\"t30\\"] - med\\n    ranks = {k: cs_rank({s: x[k] for s,x in feat.items()}) for k in FACTORS}\\n    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k] * ranks[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}\\n    breadth = np.mean([x[\\"t30\\"] > 0 for x in feat.values()]); medvol = np.median([x[\\"vol\\"] for x in feat.values()])\\n    # High-risk, uneven recovery: retain full investment but rotate toward defensives.\\n    if breadth < .60 or medvol > .018:\\n        for s in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"): score[s] += .55\\n        for s in (\\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"WTI\\"): score[s] -= .40\\n    invvol = {s: medvol/x[\\"vol\\"] for s,x in feat.items()}\\n    target = make_weights(score, invvol)\\n    if set(target) == set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()): rebalance_to_weights(target)\\n\\ndef strategy(): return cross_asset_strategy()\\n","file_path":"strategy.py"}', call_id='call_GvEWRN20zjE0uURzyzvDYM71', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0a47de71f4d9e0da016a7b5d402b84819186b7787d79297700', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

MAX_W for s in high)\\n        for s in high: w[s] = MAX_W\\n        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in high]\\n        denom = sum(raw[s] for s in rest)\\n        if not rest or denom <= 0: break\\n        for s in rest: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / denom\\n    total = sum(w.values())\\n    return {s: max(0.0, w[s] / total) for s in ASSETS}\\n\\n@register_hook\\ndef cross_asset_strategy():\\n    global _day\\n    _day += 1\\n    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:\\n        return\\n    f = {}\\n    for s in ASSETS:\\n        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=220)\\n        if df is None or len(df) < 90: continue\\n        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values(\'date\').iloc[:-1][\'close\'], dtype=float)\\n        if len(c) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-65:])) or np.any(c[-65:] <= 0): continue\\n        r = c[1:]/c[:-1]-1\\n        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)\\n        v60 = max(float(np.std(r[-60:])), .006)\\n        neg = r[-60:][r[-60:] < 0]\\n        dvol = max(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg)>1 else v60, .006)\\n        t5, t10, t20, t30, t60 = (c[-1]/c[-k-1]-1 for k in (5,10,20,30,60))\\n        # Path efficiency rewards persistent movement rather than noisy trend.\\n        efficiency = abs(t20) / (np.sum(np.abs(r[-20:])) + .02)\\n        f[s] = {\\n            \'invvol\': 1/(.7*v20+.3*v60),\\n            # Lower persistent downside incidence is defensive; rank is inverted.\\n            \'downbreadth\': -float(np.mean(r[-60:] < 0)),\\n            # Contrarian recovery: rebound from a recent low, moderated by drawdown.\\n            \'recovery\': t5 - import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Current Screener ensemble (8 active factors; all computed from completed bars).
FACTORS = {"downbreadth": .18, "breadth_mom": .17, "consistency_mom": .16,
           "recovery": .13, "switch": .12, "recovery_accel": .10,
           "persistence": .08, "downvol": .06}
REBALANCE_DAYS = 10
MIN_W, MAX_W = .04, .14
_day = 0


def rank(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    n = len(good)
    if n:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good): out[s] = (i + 1.) / n
    return out


def weights(raw):
    raw = {s: max(float(raw.get(s, .01)), 1e-8) for s in ASSETS}
    free = 1. - len(ASSETS) * MIN_W
    w = {s: MIN_W + free * raw[s] / sum(raw.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    for _ in range(30):
        over = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > MAX_W + 1e-12]
        if not over: break
        excess = sum(w[s] - MAX_W for s in over)
        for s in over: w[s] = MAX_W
        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in over]
        den = sum(raw[s] for s in rest)
        for s in rest: w[s] += excess * raw[s] / den
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in ASSETS}


@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % REBALANCE_DAYS != 0:
        return
    d = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=230)
        if df is None or len(df) < 100: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date").iloc[:-1]["close"], dtype=float)
        if len(c) < 65 or np.any(~np.isfinite(c[-65:])) or np.any(c[-65:] <= 0): continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1.
        v20 = max(float(np.std(r[-20:])), .006)
        neg = r[-20:][r[-20:] < 0]
        t1 = float(r[-1]); t5 = c[-1] / c[-6] - 1.; t10 = c[-1] / c[-11] - 1.
        t20 = c[-1] / c[-21] - 1.; t30 = c[-1] / c[-31] - 1.; t60 = c[-1] / c[-61] - 1.
        cons = float(np.mean(r[-20:] > 0))
        d[s] = {
            # Higher is safer: fewer negative days and less downside volatility.
            "downbreadth": -(0.6 * np.mean(r[-20:] < 0) + 0.4 * np.mean(r[-60:] < 0)),
            "breadth_mom": t20 / v20 * (0.35 + 0.65 * cons),
            "consistency_mom": t20 / v20 * cons,
            "recovery": t5 - .30 * min(t30, 0.),
            "switch": t10 / (v20 + .01) if t30 >= 0 else -t5 / (v20 + .01),
            "recovery_accel": (t10 - t30) / (v20 + .01),
            "persistence": t30 / (v20 + .01) * (.4 + .6 * cons),
            "downvol": -(float(np.std(neg)) if len(neg) > 1 else v20),
            "vol": v20, "t30": t30, "t60": t60
        }
    if len(d) < 10: return
    rr = {k: rank({s: x[k] for s, x in d.items()}) for k in FACTORS}
    score = {s: sum(FACTORS[k] * rr[k][s] for k in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    medvol = float(np.median([x["vol"] for x in d.values()]))
    breadth = float(np.mean([x["t30"] > 0 for x in d.values()]))
    # High-risk sideways/bear overlay: defensive tradables, not cash.
    if medvol > .018 or breadth < .60:
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"): score[s] += .24
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI"): score[s] *= .60
    raw = {s: (max(score[s], .03) * np.clip(medvol / d[s]["vol"], .70, 1.25)
               if s in d else .03) for s in ASSETS}
    target = weights(raw)
    if all(np.isfinite(target[s]) and target[s] >= 0 for s in ASSETS) and abs(sum(target.values()) - 1.) < 1e-8:
        rebalance_to_weights(target)


def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Current screener ensemble; capped at eight active factors.
FACTORS = {"quiet": .24, "relative": .18, "accel": .16, "compression": .15,
           "stress": .10, "breadth": .08, "dispersion_rev": .05, "shock_rev": .04}
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0

def rank_cs(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / n
    return out

def bounded(score):
    # Full investment across all 15 assets; bounds remain sensible for this small universe.
    floor, cap = .015, .25
    x = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), 1e-8) for s in ASSETS}
    free = 1.0 - floor * len(ASSETS)
    w = {s: floor + free*x[s]/sum(x.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    for _ in range(20):
        hi = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > cap]
        if not hi: break
        excess = sum(w[s]-cap for s in hi)
        for s in hi: w[s] = cap
        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in hi]
        den = sum(x[s] for s in rest)
        for s in rest: w[s] += excess*x[s]/max(den, 1e-12)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s]/z for s in ASSETS}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80: continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date").iloc[:-1]["close"], dtype=float)
        close = close[np.isfinite(close) & (close > 0)]
        if len(close) < 75: continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.
        v10=max(np.std(r[-10:]), .003); v20=max(np.std(r[-20:]), .003); v60=max(np.std(r[-60:]), .003)
        t1=close[-1]/close[-2]-1.; t3=close[-1]/close[-4]-1.
        t5=close[-1]/close[-6]-1.; t10=close[-1]/close[-11]-1.
        t20=close[-1]/close[-21]-1.; t30=close[-1]/close[-31]-1.
        # All signals use completed observations only and are cross-sectional ranks.
        quiet= t20/v60 * abs(t20)/(np.sum(abs(r[-20:]))+1e-9)
        relative=t20/(v20+.01)
        accel=(t10/(v10+.01))-(t20/(v20+.01))
        compression=-v10/v60
        stress=(t10 if t30 >= 0 else -t10)/(v20+.01)
        breadth=t30/(v60+.01)
        dispersion=np.std([x for x in r[-10:]])
        dispersion_rev=-t5/(v10+.01) * (dispersion/(v60+.003))
        shock_rev=-t1/(v10+.01) * min(1.5, v10/(v60+.003))
        data[s] = dict(quiet=quiet, relative=relative, accel=accel, compression=compression,
                       stress=stress, breadth=breadth, dispersion_rev=dispersion_rev,
                       shock_rev=shock_rev, vol=v20, t30=t30)
    if len(data) < 10: return
    ranks={f:rank_cs({s:d[f] for s,d in data.items()}) for f in FACTORS}
    score={s:sum(FACTORS[f]*ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth=np.mean([d["t30"] > 0 for d in data.values()])
    spx30=data.get("SPX", {}).get("t30", 0.)
    # High-risk bearish regime: remain fully invested but migrate toward defensive tradables.
    bear = breadth < .45 or spx30 < -.05
    if bear:
        intensity=min(1., max(0., (.45-breadth)*1.8) + max(0., (-spx30-.02)/.18))
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"):
            score[s] *= 1.0 + .75*intensity
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "SOX", "NDX", "COPPER"):
            score[s] *= max(.20, 1.0-.65*intensity)
    median_vol=np.median([d["vol"] for d in data.values()])
    for s in ASSETS:
        score[s]=max(.01, score[s]) * np.clip(median_vol/max(data.get(s,{}).get("vol",median_vol),.003), .65, 1.30)
    target=bounded(score)
    if set(target) == set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()) and abs(sum(target.values())-1.) < 1e-8:
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Current screener ensemble; capped at eight active factors.
FACTORS = {"quiet": .24, "relative": .18, "accel": .16, "compression": .15,
           "stress": .10, "breadth": .08, "dispersion_rev": .05, "shock_rev": .04}
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0

def rank_cs(values):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in values.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    n = len(good)
    for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good):
        out[s] = (i + 1.) / n
    return out

def bounded(score):
    # Full investment across all 15 assets; bounds remain sensible for this small universe.
    floor, cap = .015, .25
    x = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), 1e-8) for s in ASSETS}
    free = 1.0 - floor * len(ASSETS)
    w = {s: floor + free*x[s]/sum(x.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    for _ in range(20):
        hi = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > cap]
        if not hi: break
        excess = sum(w[s]-cap for s in hi)
        for s in hi: w[s] = cap
        rest = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in hi]
        den = sum(x[s] for s in rest)
        for s in rest: w[s] += excess*x[s]/max(den, 1e-12)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s]/z for s in ASSETS}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0:
        return
    data = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=260)
        if df is None or len(df) < 80: continue
        close = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date").iloc[:-1]["close"], dtype=float)
        close = close[np.isfinite(close) & (close > 0)]
        if len(close) < 75: continue
        r = close[1:] / close[:-1] - 1.
        v10=max(np.std(r[-10:]), .003); v20=max(np.std(r[-20:]), .003); v60=max(np.std(r[-60:]), .003)
        t1=close[-1]/close[-2]-1.; t3=close[-1]/close[-4]-1.
        t5=close[-1]/close[-6]-1.; t10=close[-1]/close[-11]-1.
        t20=close[-1]/close[-21]-1.; t30=close[-1]/close[-31]-1.
        # All signals use completed observations only and are cross-sectional ranks.
        quiet= t20/v60 * abs(t20)/(np.sum(abs(r[-20:]))+1e-9)
        relative=t20/(v20+.01)
        accel=(t10/(v10+.01))-(t20/(v20+.01))
        compression=-v10/v60
        stress=(t10 if t30 >= 0 else -t10)/(v20+.01)
        breadth=t30/(v60+.01)
        dispersion=np.std([x for x in r[-10:]])
        dispersion_rev=-t5/(v10+.01) * (dispersion/(v60+.003))
        shock_rev=-t1/(v10+.01) * min(1.5, v10/(v60+.003))
        data[s] = dict(quiet=quiet, relative=relative, accel=accel, compression=compression,
                       stress=stress, breadth=breadth, dispersion_rev=dispersion_rev,
                       shock_rev=shock_rev, vol=v20, t30=t30)
    if len(data) < 10: return
    ranks={f:rank_cs({s:d[f] for s,d in data.items()}) for f in FACTORS}
    score={s:sum(FACTORS[f]*ranks[f][s] for f in FACTORS) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth=np.mean([d["t30"] > 0 for d in data.values()])
    spx30=data.get("SPX", {}).get("t30", 0.)
    # High-risk bearish regime: remain fully invested but migrate toward defensive tradables.
    bear = breadth < .45 or spx30 < -.05
    if bear:
        intensity=min(1., max(0., (.45-breadth)*1.8) + max(0., (-spx30-.02)/.18))
        for s in ("XAU", "US10Y", "CN10Y"):
            score[s] *= 1.0 + .75*intensity
        for s in ("BTC", "ETH", "WTI", "SOX", "NDX", "COPPER"):
            score[s] *= max(.20, 1.0-.65*intensity)
    median_vol=np.median([d["vol"] for d in data.values()])
    for s in ASSETS:
        score[s]=max(.01, score[s]) * np.clip(median_vol/max(data.get(s,{}).get("vol",median_vol),.003), .65, 1.30)
    target=bounded(score)
    if set(target) == set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()) and abs(sum(target.values())-1.) < 1e-8:
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

def strategy():
    return cross_asset_strategy()
"}

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# Screener 2029-12-27 ensemble (10 active factors; all directions positive).
FW = {"compression": .18, "shock": .14, "stress": .14, "breadth": .13,
      "quiet": .10, "relative": .10, "risk_rev": .08,
      "dispersion_rev": .07, "volume_rev": .03, "breadth_rel": .03}
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0

def rank_cs(vals):
    good = sorted((s, float(v)) for s, v in vals.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    if len(good) > 1:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(good): out[s] = i / (len(good) - 1)
    return out

def bounded(score):
    # Complete, long-only, full-investment vector: 2% floor, 20% cap.
    floor, cap = .02, .20
    x = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), .01) for s in ASSETS}
    free = 1.0 - floor * len(ASSETS)
    w = {s: floor + free * x[s] / sum(x.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    for _ in range(30):
        hi = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > cap]
        if not hi: break
        excess = sum(w[s] - cap for s in hi)
        for s in hi: w[s] = cap
        lo = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in hi]
        z = sum(x[s] for s in lo)
        for s in lo: w[s] += excess * x[s] / max(z, 1e-12)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s] / z for s in ASSETS}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % CADENCE: return
    feat = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 100: continue
        # Only completed sessions are used; no look-ahead.
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date").iloc[:-1]["close"], dtype=float)
        c = c[np.isfinite(c) & (c > 0)]
        if len(c) < 80: continue
        r = c[1:] / c[:-1] - 1
        neg = r[-30:][r[-30:] < 0]
        feat[s] = dict(t3=c[-1]/c[-4]-1, t5=c[-1]/c[-6]-1,
          t10=c[-1]/c[-11]-1, t20=c[-1]/c[-21]-1,
          t30=c[-1]/c[-31]-1, t60=c[-1]/c[-61]-1,
          v10=max(np.std(r[-10:]), .003), v20=max(np.std(r[-20:]), .003),
          v60=max(np.std(r[-60:]), .003), downv=max(np.std(neg) if len(neg)>2 else np.std(r[-20:]), .003),
          activity=np.mean(np.abs(r[-5:]))/max(np.mean(np.abs(r[-20:])), .003))
    if len(feat) < 10: return
    m3=np.mean([d['t3'] for d in feat.values()]); m5=np.mean([d['t5'] for d in feat.values()]); m60=np.mean([d['t60'] for d in feat.values()])
    disp=max(np.std([d['t10'] for d in feat.values()]), .01)
    raw={}
    for s,d in feat.items():
        ag=np.mean([d['t10']>0,d['t20']>0,d['t60']>0])
        rev=-(d['t5']-m5)/(d['v20']+.01)
        raw[s] = {
          'compression': -d['v10']/(d['v60']+.003),
          'shock': -(d['t3']-m3)/(d['v10']+.01),
          'stress': (d['t10'] if d['t30']>=0 else -d['t10'])/(d['v20']+.01),
          'breadth': d['t30']*(.5+.5*ag)/(d['v60']+.01),
          'quiet': d['t20']*abs(d['t20'])/(d['v60']+.01),
          'relative': d['t20']/(d['v20']+.01),
          'risk_rev': -(d['t60']-m60)/(d['v60']+.01),
          'dispersion_rev': rev*min(2.,disp/.03),
          'volume_rev': rev*(1+.2*min(d['activity'],2.)),
          'breadth_rel': d['t20']*(.5+.5*ag)/(d['v20']+.01)}
    ranks={f:rank_cs({s:raw[s][f] for s in raw}) for f in FW}
    score={s:sum(FW[f]*ranks[f].get(s,.5) for f in FW) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth=np.mean([d['t30']>0 for d in feat.values()]); spx=feat.get('SPX',{}).get('t30',0.)
    risk=float(np.clip((.50-breadth)*1.8+max(0.,(-spx-.01)/.15),0.,1.))
    # Defensive tradable assets replace a cash sleeve in the bearish regime.
    for s in ('XAU','US10Y','CN10Y'): score[s] *= 1+1.25*risk
    for s in ('BTC','ETH','WTI','SOX','NDX','COPPER'): score[s] *= max(.15,1-.75*risk)
    med=np.median([d['v20'] for d in feat.values()])
    for s in ASSETS:
        score[s]=max(.01,score[s])*np.clip(med/max(feat.get(s,{}).get('v20',med),.003),.75,1.20)
    target=bounded(score)
    if set(target)==set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v>=0 for v in target.values()): rebalance_to_weights(target)

def strategy():
    cross_asset_strategy()

- Applied defensive tilts toward XAU, US10Y, and CN10Y.

### Observations
- Live performance declined sharply relative to the previous +3.81% block.
- Results are consistent with an unstable sideways-to-bearish regime.
- Backtest and live outcomes were both weak, so the prior strong live performance appears non-persistent.
- Full-investment and defensive tilts functioned as intended without execution problems.

### Feedback to Screener
- Retain compression, stress-risk, downside-breadth, quiet trend, and relative-risk factors as core components.
- Keep one-day shock reversal capped at its current 5% pilot weight pending stronger recent evidence.
- Do not increase reversal concentration or turnover-sensitive factor weights.
- Continue monitoring the discrepancy between factor backtests and short live samples.

### Plans
- Maintain the current ensemble, 2%–20% bounds, inverse-volatility moderation, defensive overlay, and 10-day cadence.
- Avoid hyperparameter expansion after this weak cycle.
- Reassess only after additional live observations or clearer improvement in breadth and market trend.

import numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import register_hook, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights

ASSETS = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX", "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
# 2030-03-21 screener ensemble; capped at seven active factors.
FW = {"quiet": .34, "relative": .25, "compression": .12, "stress": .10,
      "breadth": .10, "consistency": .06, "reversal": .03}
CADENCE = 10
_day = 0

def ranks(x):
    out = {s: .5 for s in ASSETS}
    a = sorted((s, v) for s, v in x.items() if np.isfinite(v))
    if len(a) > 1:
        for i, (s, _) in enumerate(a): out[s] = i / (len(a) - 1)
    return out

def bounded(score):
    # 2% floor and 20% cap preserve a complete, fully invested target.
    floor, cap = .02, .20
    b = {s: max(float(score.get(s, .5)), .01) for s in ASSETS}
    w = {s: floor + (1-floor*len(ASSETS))*b[s]/sum(b.values()) for s in ASSETS}
    for _ in range(100):
        hi = [s for s in ASSETS if w[s] > cap + 1e-12]
        if not hi: break
        excess = sum(w[s]-cap for s in hi)
        for s in hi: w[s] = cap
        lo = [s for s in ASSETS if s not in hi]
        z = sum(b[s] for s in lo)
        for s in lo: w[s] += excess*b[s]/max(z, 1e-12)
    z = sum(w.values())
    return {s: w[s]/z for s in ASSETS}

@register_hook
def cross_asset_strategy():
    global _day
    _day += 1
    if (_day - 1) % CADENCE != 0: return
    feat = {}
    for s in ASSETS:
        df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=s, days=280)
        if df is None or len(df) < 100: continue
        c = np.asarray(df.sort_values("date").iloc[:-1]["close"], float)
        c = c[np.isfinite(c) & (c > 0)]
        if len(c) < 80: continue
        r = c[1:]/c[:-1]-1
        dn = r[-60:][r[-60:] < 0]
        feat[s] = dict(t10=c[-1]/c[-11]-1, t20=c[-1]/c[-21]-1,
                       t30=c[-1]/c[-31]-1, t60=c[-1]/c[-61]-1,
                       v10=max(np.std(r[-10:]),.003), v20=max(np.std(r[-20:]),.003),
                       v60=max(np.std(r[-60:]),.003), downv=max(np.std(dn) if len(dn)>2 else np.std(r[-20:]),.003))
    if len(feat) < 10: return
    vals = list(feat.values())
    median_v = np.median([d["v20"] for d in vals])
    cross_disp = max(np.std([d["t10"] for d in vals]), .01)
    raw = {f: {} for f in FW}
    for s,d in feat.items():
        agree = np.mean([d["t10"]>0, d["t20"]>0, d["t60"]>0])
        raw["quiet"][s] = d["t20"]/(d["v60"]+.01) * (.5+.5*agree)
        raw["relative"][s] = d["t20"]/(d["v20"]+.01)
        # Compression is a positive low-volatility state signal.
        raw["compression"][s] = -d["v10"]/(d["v60"]+.003)
        raw["stress"][s] = (d["t10"] if d["t30"]>=0 else -d["t10"])/(d["downv"]+.01)
        raw["breadth"][s] = d["t30"]*(.5+.5*agree)/(d["downv"]+.01)
        raw["consistency"][s] = (d["t10"]+d["t20"]+d["t60"])/3/(d["v60"]+.01) * agree
        raw["reversal"][s] = -(d["t10"]-np.mean([x["t10"] for x in vals]))/(d["v20"]+.01)*min(1.5,cross_disp/.03)
    rr = {f: ranks(raw[f]) for f in FW}
    score = {s: sum(FW[f]*rr[f].get(s,.5) for f in FW) for s in ASSETS}
    breadth = np.mean([d["t30"]>0 for d in vals])
    spx30 = feat.get("SPX",{}).get("t30",0.)
    # Bullish but unstable: retain trend, materially favor defensive tradables.
    risk = float(np.clip((.60-breadth)*1.5 + max(0, (np.std([x["t10"] for x in vals])-.025)/.05) + max(0,(-spx30-.02)/.12),0,1))
    for s in ("XAU","US10Y","CN10Y"): score[s] *= 1 + 1.25*risk
    for s in ("BTC","ETH","WTI","SOX","NDX","COPPER"): score[s] *= max(.20,1-.65*risk)
    for s in ASSETS:
        score[s] = max(.01,score[s]) * np.clip(median_v/max(feat.get(s,{}).get("v20",median_v),.003),.75,1.20)
    target = bounded(score)
    if set(target) == set(ASSETS) and all(np.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in target.values()):
        rebalance_to_weights(target)

def strategy():
    cross_asset_strategy()

The complete 15-asset target and\\n10-day deterministic forecasts are sent to the migration-cost gate.\\n\\"\\"\\"\\nimport json, math\\nimport numpy as np\\nimport pandas as pd\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import (get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data,\\n    rebalance_to_weights, register_hook)\\n\\nONLINE_START = \\"2026-07-16\\"\\nDATE_FILE = \\"../persistent/date.json\\"\\nSTATE_FILE = \\"trader_state.json\\"\\nASSET_COUNT = 15\\nLOOKBACK = 170\\nCAP = 0.16\\n\\nwith open(\\"factor_ensemble.json\\", encoding=\\"utf-8\\") as fh:\\n    _ensemble = json.load(fh)[\\"selected_factors\\"]\\nFACTORS = [(x[\\"factor_id\\"], float(x[\\"weight\\"]), int(x[\\"direction\\"]))\\n           for x in _ensemble]\\n\\n\\ndef _window(fid):\\n    f = fid.lower()\\n    if \\"compression\\" in f: return 10, 60\\n    if \\"breadth\\" in f: return 30, 30\\n    if \\"stress\\" in f: return 5, 20\\n    if \\"leadlag\\" in f: return 5, 5\\n    if \\"reversal\\" in f or \\"residual\\" in f: return 3, 3\\n    if \\"agreement\\" in f: return 20, 60\\n    if \\"relative_risk\\" in f: return 20, 60\\n    return 20, 20\\n\\n\\ndef _signal(df, fid):\\n    c = df.close.astype(float)\\n    r = c.pct_change()\\n    f = fid.lower(); used = 0\\n    for fid, weight, direction in FACTORS[:10]:\\n        vals = {}\\n        for a in assets:\\n            try:\\n                s = _signal(frames[a], fid) if frames[a] is not None else None\\n                v = float(s.iloc[-1]) if s is not None else float(\\"nan\\")\\n                vals[a] = v if math.isfinite(v) else None\\n            except Exception: vals[a] = None\\n        if sum(v is not None for v in vals.values()) < 8: continue\\n        rr = _rank(vals, assets)\\n        for a in assets: score[a] += weight * (rr[a] if direction > 0 else 1-rr[a])\\n        used += 1\\n    if used == 0: return {a: 1/ASSET_COUNT for a in assets}, score\\n    # Smooth rank exposure, then cap concentration and renormalize.\\n    raw = {a: .025 + .10 * score[a] for a in assets}\\n    w = {a: x / sum(raw.values()) for a, x in raw.items()}\\n    for _ in range(20):\\n        over = sum(max(0., x-CAP) for x in w.values())\\n        if over < 1e-12: break\\n        room = [a for a in assets if w[a] < CAP-1e-12]\\n        for a in assets: w[a] = min(w[a], CAP)\\n        den = sum(w[a] for a in room) or 1.\\n        for a in room: w[a] += over*w[a]/den\\n    z = sum(w.values()); The complete 15-asset target and\\n10-day deterministic forecasts are sent to the migration-cost gate.\\n\\"\\"\\"\\nimport json, math\\nimport numpy as np\\nimport pandas as pd\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import (get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data,\\n    rebalance_to_weights, register_hook)\\n\\nONLINE_START = \\"2026-07-16\\"\\nDATE_FILE = \\"../persistent/date.json\\"\\nSTATE_FILE = \\"trader_state.json\\"\\nASSET_COUNT = 15\\nLOOKBACK = 170\\nCAP = 0.16\\n\\nwith open(\\"factor_ensemble.json\\", encoding=\\"utf-8\\") as fh:\\n    _ensemble = json.load(fh)[\\"selected_factors\\"]\\nFACTORS = [(x[\\"factor_id\\"], float(x[\\"weight\\"]), int(x[\\"direction\\"]))\\n           for x in _ensemble]\\n\\n\\ndef _window(fid):\\n    f = fid.lower()\\n    if \\"compression\\" in f: return 10, 60\\n    if \\"breadth\\" in f: return 30, 30\\n    if \\"stress\\" in f: return 5, 20\\n    if \\"leadlag\\" in f: return 5, 5\\n    if \\"reversal\\" in f or \\"residual\\" in f: return 3, 3\\n    if \\"agreement\\" in f: return 20, 60\\n    if \\"relative_risk\\" in f: return 20, 60\\n    return 20, 20\\n\\n\\ndef _signal(df, fid):\\n    c = df.close.astype(float)\\n    r = c.pct_change()\\n    f = fid.lower(); Screener agent output from current cycle: ## Market Assessment
- **Trend:** Sideways to mildly bullish; current market-data confirmation was unavailable.

- **Volatility:** Compressed/low relative volatility, favoring stable and defensive factors.
- **Liquidity:** No execution deterioration reported; turnover remains important given the 10-trading-day cadence.

## Available Factors
- **Momentum/Trend:** Quiet trend, relative-risk trend, downside trend, consistency-gated momentum, trend agreement.
- **Low-Risk/Volatility:** Volatility compression, downside-volatility asymmetry.
- **Breadth/Defensive:** Downside-adjusted breadth trend, stress-risk trend.

- **Peer-median lead-lag — 10%:** Diversifies the trend cluster but carries higher turnover and cross-asset dependence.
- **Trend agreement — 3%:** Small confirmation allocation only.

- Use rank normalization, winsorization, lagged exposures, and inverse-volatility moderation downstream.

- The prior live cycle, 2031-04-03 through 2031-04-17, returned **-0.24%**, with Sharpe **-1.88** and maximum drawdown **0.71%**.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"\\"\\"\\"Cross-asset 15-instrument, long-only factor ensemble.\\"\\"\\"\\nimport json, math\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_account_dict, get_stock_daily_data, rebalance_to_weights, register_hook\\n\\nSTART = \\"2026-07-16\\"\\nDATE_FILE = \\"../persistent/date.json\\"\\nSTATE_FILE = \\"trader_state.json\\"\\nCAP = 0.16\\nASSET_SET = {\\"000300.SH\\", \\"SPX\\", \\"HSI\\", \\"N225\\", \\"SX5E\\", \\"000688.SH\\", \\"SOX\\", \\"NDX\\", \\"XAU\\", \\"COPPER\\", \\"WTI\\", \\"BTC\\", \\"ETH\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"}\\nwith open(\\"factor_ensemble.json\\", encoding=\\"utf-8\\") as f:\\n    FACTORS = [(x[\\"factor_id\\"], float(x[\\"weight\\"]), int(x.get(\\"direction\\", 1)))\\n               for x in json.load(f).get(\\"selected_factors\\", [])[:10]]\\n\\n\\ndef signal(df, fid, peer_returns):\\n    c = df.close.astype(float); r = c.pct_change(); f = fid.lower()\\n    if \\"dispersion\\" in f:\\n        # Residual reversal, active only when recent cross-sectional dispersion contracts.\\n        own = c.pct_change(5)\\n        med = peer_returns.rolling(5).median(axis=1)\\n        disp = peer_returns.rolling(5).std(axis=1)\\n        x = -(own - med) * (disp.iloc[-1] < disp.rolling(20).median().iloc[-1])\\n    elif \\"compression\\" in f:\\n        x = -(r.rolling(10).std() / r.rolling(60).std())\\n    elif \\"breadth\\" in f:\\n        x = r.gt(0).rolling(30).mean() - 0.5\\n    elif \\"stress\\" in f:\\n        x = -(r.rolling(5).std() / r.rolling(20).std())\\n    elif \\"leadlag\\" in f:\\n        x = c.pct_change(5) - c.pct_change(5).rolling(5).mean()\\n    elif \\"relative_risk\\" in f:\\n        x = c.pct_change(20) / r.rolling(20).std()\\n    else:\\n        x = c.pct_change(20) / r.rolling(60).std()\\n    x = x.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).shift(1)\\n    return float(x.iloc[-1]) if len(x) and math.isfinite(float(x.iloc[-1])) else None\\n\\n\\ndef rank(vals, assets):\\n    good = sorted((v, a) for a, v in vals.items() if v is not None and math.isfinite(v))\\n    out = {a: .5 for a in assets}\\n    for i, (_, a) in enumerate(good): out[a] = i / max(1, len(good)-1)\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef weights(frames, assets):\\n    rets = {a: frames[a].close.astype(float).pct_change() for a in assets}\\n    peer = __import__(\'pandas\').DataFrame(rets)\\n    score = {a: 0.0 for a in assets}\\n    for fid, wt, direction in FACTORS:\\n        vals = {a: signal(frames[a], fid, peer) for a in assets}\\n        if sum(v is not None for v in vals.values()) < 8: continue\\n        rr = rank(vals, assets)\\n        for a in assets: score[a] += wt * (rr[a] if direction > 0 else 1-rr[a])\\n    w = {a: .025 + .10 * score[a] for a in assets}\\n    z = sum(w.values()); w = {a: x/z for a,x in w.items()}\\n    # Full-investment defensive tilt when weakness is broad, never a cash sleeve.\\n    weak = sum(float(frames[a].close.iloc[-1]) < float(frames[a].close.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]) for a in assets)\\n    if weak >= 10:\\n        for a in (\\"XAU\\", \\"US10Y\\", \\"CN10Y\\"):\\n            w[a] += .025\\n        z = sum(w.values()); w = {a:x/z for a,x in w.items()}\\n    # Cap concentration and redistribute excess proportionally.\\n    for _ in range(20):\\n        excess = sum(max(0., x-CAP) for x in w.values())\\n        if excess < 1e-10: break\\n        room = [a for a in assets if w[a] < CAP-1e-10]\\n        for a in assets: w[a] = min(w[a], CAP)\\n        den = sum(w[a] for a in room)\\n        if not room or den <= 0: break\\n        for a in room: w[a] += excess*w[a]/den\\n    z=sum(w.values()); assets=list(account.get(\\"watch_list\\", []))\\n    if set(assets) != ASSET_SET or len(assets)!=15 or not FACTORS: return\\n    frames={}\\n    for a in assets:\\n        x=get_stock_daily_data(symbol=a, days=180)\\n        frames[a]=None if x is None or len(x)<100 else x.sort_values(\\"date\\").set_index(\\"date\\")\\n    if any(x is None for x in frames.values()): return\\n    w, score=weights(frames, assets)\\n    mean=np.mean(list(score.values()));
